section_3_1_claim_atomicity.mechanism: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction + UNIQUE(task_id, request_id) constraint
section_3_1_claim_atomicity.concurrency_protection: Cross-process serialization guaranteed by SQLite exclusive lock; in-memory asyncio.Lock serializes intra-process tasks
section_3_1_claim_atomicity.revision_validation: Expected revision verified against latest_working_state inside transaction before claim insert

section_3_2_commit_before_response_safet.scenario: State committed to revision N+1, server crashes before complete_cycle_execution caches outcome
section_3_2_commit_before_response_safet.replay_protection: Re-sending same request_id returns HTTP 409 ('previous cycle execution terminated with interrupted'). Re-sending with expected_revision=N returns HTTP 409 ('expected N, current is N+1').

section_3_3_task_deletion_coordination.mechanism: Double-checked task existence check via cpp_backend.get_task(task_id)
section_3_3_task_deletion_coordination.timing: Check 1: Prior to claim_cycle_execution; Check 2: Immediately after execute_cycle before complete_cycle_execution
section_3_3_task_deletion_coordination.deletion_during_execution: Catches deleted tasks, transitions cycle to failed, returns HTTP 404, prevents zombie authoritative state persistence
